headline: Positive approach signal offset by a structural accuracy deficit
story_hook: Approach play at the 81st percentile gives this player a viable path at Detroit Golf Club, where the iron game drives scoring. The concern is a driving accuracy score at the 18th percentile — well below the threshold where tree-lined corridors become punishing. A single-start venue sample limits the course-history signal. The projection is positive but the accuracy risk is real and carries a high-severity flag.

failure_scenario: The projection breaks if driving accuracy misses trigger a round of blocked approaches and penalty strokes, outpacing the birdie rate the approach play can generate.
